definitions.gloss: to devote oneself; to dedicate oneself selflessly
definitions.explanation: To give oneself wholeheartedly to a cause, person, or purpose, often with self-sacrifice implied.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{献身|けんしん}する。
examples.english: To devote oneself to one's family.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{医療|いりょう}→医療：01836_iryou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{献身|けんしん}してきた。
examples.english: She has devoted herself to community healthcare.

examples.japanese: ⟦{生涯|しょうがい}→生涯：03229_shougai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教育|きょういく}→教育：01313_kyouiku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{献身|けんしん}し、{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{育|そだ}てた→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧⟦{恩師|おんし}→恩師：12598_onshi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{感謝|かんしゃ}している→感謝する：06055_kanshasuru⟧。
examples.english: I am grateful to the mentor who devoted their entire life to education and nurtured many students.

notes:
Composed of {献|けん} (to offer, dedicate) + {身|しん} (body, self). Implies selfless dedication, often with a sense of sacrifice. The noun form ⟦{献身|けんしん}→献身：10892_kenshin⟧ is also common, often used as a modifier: ⟦{献身的|けんしんてき}→献身的：06263_kenshinteki⟧ (devoted, selfless).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{献身的|けんしんてき}→献身的：06263_kenshinteki⟧な — devoted, selfless, dedicated
- ⟦{献身的|けんしんてき}→献身的：06263_kenshinteki⟧な⟦{介護|かいご}→介護：04805_kaigo⟧ — devoted caregiving
- ⟦{献身的|けんしんてき}→献身的：06263_kenshinteki⟧な⟦{愛|あい}→愛：02370_ai⟧ — selfless love
- {献身|けんしん}する⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧ — attitude of devotion

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{尽|つ}くす→尽くす：02077_tsukusu⟧ — to serve devotedly, to exhaust oneself for someone; more everyday
- ⟦{捧|ささ}げる→捧げる：02055_sasageru⟧ — to dedicate, to offer up; emphasizes giving something (life, time) to a cause
- ⟦{傾注|けいちゅう}する→傾注する：19727_keichuusuru⟧ — to concentrate all one's effort; more intellectual, less self-sacrificing
